messages:
Kelsey: Quick heads up — Jin submitted resignation today, last day 2026-04-10 (two weeks). Need to confirm benefits/COBRA cutoff, exit interview window, and who handles staggered access removal for AWS keys and service tokens. Thinking: revoke interactive SSO on last day but stagger service creds 48–72h. Any objections?

Elena: Thanks Kelsey — benefits remain active through the end of the month in our plan. So because last day is 4/10, health/dental/vision stay active until 2026-04-30. COBRA paperwork should be issued 2026-04-11 (the next business day) and employees have 60 days to elect. I will prepare the packet and include HSA rollover instructions and 401k vendor contact.

Kelsey: Great — please include a line about final paycheck proration & who to contact in payroll. Also we should confirm exact COBRA mailing/opt-in link for remote employees.

Sam: Manager says there may be a prorated bonus for partial month — cc @Payroll (I'll flag separately). Also let's schedule the exit interview for the week of 4/6 so we capture knowledge before last week. @Kelsey can you send the invite?

People Ops: Will set up exit interview (30–45m). Standard agenda + short offboarding survey. I'll send Calendly options today and aim for 4/07 or 4/08.

IT Bot: Offboard automation scan: assets assigned: MacBook Pro (serial X123), YubiKey, company phone, AWS Console access, personal SSH keys with deploy role access. Suggested timeline per runbook: laptop return by EOD last day; revoke SSO at 17:00 PT on last day; terminate console sessions + rotate user access keys 48h after last day; revoke and rotate long-lived service tokens/CI creds 72h after last day. If anyone needs exceptions, open an IT ticket. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/offboard-runbook

Sam: Can we hold off on Jenkins/CI token rotation until after Jin finishes on-call? Jin is on-call through 2026-04-09 23:59 PT, so prefer to rotate those tokens on 04/10 00:00 or 04/11 depending on shift handover.

Kelsey: Noted. Plan: keep on-call interactive creds live until 04/10 23:59, revoke interactive SSO 04/11 00:00 for safety, rotate long-lived CI/service tokens 04/12 00:00. That gives one full day buffer after last on-call shift.

Elena: COBRA & benefits communication: templates updated. I'll send COBRA packet 04/11 and retirement plan admin will send 401k rollover docs within 14 days. Please remind Jin to confirm contact info.

IT Bot: Need confirmation of asset shipping address for remote pickup. Last known address: 123 Oak St, Apt 4B. IT will generate prepaid label and email by 04/07. Please confirm.

Kelsey: Confirmed address is correct. I'll ping Jin to confirm pickup window and whether they want a UPS or FedEx label. Also we'll schedule asset return checklist and ensure YubiKey is returned before SSO revoke.

Elena: Payroll note: final pay includes prorated salary and any eligible prorated bonus. Insurance termination remains 04/30. COBRA opt-in doesn't change employer coverage through month-end.

Sam: Great — action list: 1) Kelsey send exit interview invite + confirm shipping window; 2) Elena issue COBRA + 401k docs on 04/11; 3) IT ship label 04/07 and follow deprovision schedule; 4) Payroll compute final pay and confirm proration. Kelsey please mark when items done.

Kelsey: Will do. I'll post updates here as each item is completed. :thumbsup:

People Ops: Thanks everyone — will close the loop once exit interview done and assets confirmed returned.

IT Bot: Ticket created #IT-4821 for asset pickup + cred rotation. Link: https://intra.redwood/tickets/IT-4821

Kelsey: Awesome, thanks.
